title: Application and Temporal Accuracy Binding for Groundwater Head Convergence
objective: Bind the explicit F-GC17 interface-head convergence policy to already verified project application accuracy and temporal allocation evidence without choosing a project-specific H_app, A_temporal, solver tolerance or hidden numerical default.
required_semantics: only an externally qualified application accuracy contract may bind interface policy
groundwater-head QoI only for the restricted direct-head profile
H_app and A_temporal provenance remain distinct and visible
temporal budget is H_app times A_temporal and remains solver/model budget, not automatically the interface tolerance
interface tolerance must be explicitly supplied or derived by an explicit governed allocation factor
any derived interface tolerance must be positive, finite and no larger than H_app
binding provenance must combine rather than erase upstream provenance
fail closed when any evidence, provenance or allocation is missing
hard_nonclaims: no selection of an interface allocation factor
no change to Richards temporal-indicator implementation
qualification: missing or invalid evidence fail closed
no hidden equality between temporal budget and interface tolerance
